incoming.name: Faroe Islands
incoming.excerpt: Fresh fish also features strongly in the traditional local diet, as do seabirds, such as puffins, and their eggs.

incoming.name: Svalbard
incoming.excerpt: Svalbard is also a breeding ground for large numbers of seabirds, including Brunnich's and Black Guillemot, Puffin, Little Auk, Fulmar and Kittiwake.

outgoing.name: Pelagic zone
outgoing.excerpt: These are pelagic seabirds that feed primarily by diving.
